entries.source:
@playername@, you are called to serve. The nearby unhallowed morass inhabitants are growing restless.
You must go there and find the source.
entries.target:
@playername@，你效力的时候到了。附近混沌之沼中的居民正在蠢蠢欲动。
你必须去那里，找到这一切的源头。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A slot in the door opens and a pair of wild eyes peer out.*#WHITE#
What do you want, @playerdescriptor.race@?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*门上开了一个小洞，一双狂乱的眼睛凝视着你。*#WHITE#
你想干什么，@playerdescriptor.race@？

entries.source: Paladin Aeryn told me that you could help me. I need to get to Maj'Eyal.
entries.target: 太阳骑士艾琳跟我说你能帮助我，我想去马基·埃亚尔。

entries.source: I found the Blood-Runed Athame, but there was no Resonating Diamond.
entries.target: 我找到了血符仪式匕首，不过没找到共鸣钻石。

entries.source: I have a Resonating Diamond.
entries.target: 我找到了共鸣钻石。

entries.source: Sorry, I have to go!
entries.target: 抱歉，我要走了！

entries.source:
Pfaugh! Her goal in life is to waste my time! Maj'Eyal? Why not Narnia or Chicago? Just as easy to send you someplace entirely fictional as Maj'Eyal. Go away.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Slot slams shut.*#WHITE#
entries.target:
呸！她的生活目标就是浪费我的时间！马基·埃亚尔？怎么不是纳尼亚或者芝加哥？把你送到一个完全虚构的地方，和送到马基·埃亚尔一样简单。走开。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*小洞呯的一声关上了。*#WHITE#

entries.source: I got here from Maj'Eyal, didn't I? I have this magic Orb I looted from a dead orc, see, and...
entries.target: 我来自马基·埃亚尔，不是么？我有一个从兽人尸体上找到的魔法水晶球，你看……

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Slot opens.*#WHITE#
Orb, you say? That you used to travel here from Maj'Eyal? Surely you don't possess the Orb of Many Ways! It's been lost for ages!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*小洞打开了。*#WHITE#
你说水晶球？你说你是从马基·埃亚尔来的？你拿到的肯定不是多元水晶球！它已经消失很多年了！

entries.source: [Hold up the orb]
entries.target: [拿出水晶球]

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*His eyes widen.*#WHITE#
Great Socks of Aeryn! It IS the Orb! Maybe we can get you home after all. Or maybe we can get you embedded in magma a thousand leagues straight down.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他瞪大了眼睛。*#WHITE#
艾琳的袜子啊！真是那个水晶球！说不定我们终究能让你回家，也说不定能把你嵌进正下方一千里深的岩浆里。

entries.source: May I come in?
entries.target: 我能进来了么？

entries.source:
You think I'm letting some filthy @playerdescriptor.race@ in my house with the Orb of Many Ways?
I blow myself up quite enough already without that thing in the house, thank you.
Besides, I still can't help you unless you have a Blood-Runed Athame to etch a portal.
Err, and that portal must be etched on a piece of prepared Resonating Marble.
The Gates of the Morning has a slab of Marble that once could have served, but a number of, um, incidents have taken their toll.
It'll require a Resonating Diamond to get it properly prepared. Oh, and I want 100 gold.
entries.target:
你认为我会让一个肮脏的 @playerdescriptor.race@ 带着多元水晶球进我家么？
谢了，就算屋里没有那东西，我也已经把自己炸得够呛了。
况且，我没法帮助你，除非你搞到一把血符仪式匕首来刻画这个传送门。
呃……传送门必须刻在一块准备好的共鸣大理石上。
晨曦之门原本有一块这样的共鸣大理石，不过过去发生过一些……呃……事故，对它造成了损伤。
要想妥善处理它，还需要一块共鸣钻石，哦，我还要收取 100 金币费用。

entries.source: Where can I find all that?
entries.target: 我上哪儿去找那些东西？

entries.source: Try your purse for the 100 gold. As for an Athame and a Resonating Diamond, I assume the orcs have some if they're cooking up portals to use that Orb on. Try the Vor Armory. It so happens that I know a back way in. Never mind why.
entries.target: 100 金币嘛……你摸摸自己的钱袋就有了。至于仪式匕首和共鸣钻石，既然那些兽人正准备配合多元水晶球开启传送门，我猜他们手上就有。去沃尔军械库找找吧。碰巧我知道一条从后面进去的路，别问为什么。

entries.source: Thank you.
entries.target: 谢谢。

entries.source: Of course there was no Resonating Diamond. What makes you think Briagh would let one loose for even a second?
entries.target: 你当然找不到共鸣钻石，你想想布莱亚怎么可能让一颗钻石溜走？

entries.source: Briagh?
entries.target: 布莱亚？

entries.source: Briagh the Great Sand Wyrm. Where do you think Resonating Diamonds come from? They're just regular diamonds until they get stuck between Briagh's scales for a few centuries and get infused with his life rhythms. He sleeps on a hoard of precious gems and metals, you see.
entries.target: 布莱亚，那条巨型沙龙。你以为共鸣钻石是从哪里来的？它们原本只是普通的钻石，卡在布莱亚的鳞片间长达几个世纪，逐渐融入了它的生命节律。你看，它就睡在一堆珍贵宝石和金属上。

entries.source: Where might I find Briagh's lair??
entries.target: 布莱亚的老巢在什么地方？？

entries.source: Well south of the Sunwall. I'll mark it for you on your map.
entries.target: 在太阳堡垒以南很远的地方，我会在你的地图上给你做个记号。

entries.source: I'll be back with a Resonating Diamond.
entries.target: 我会带回共鸣钻石。

entries.source: Yes? You got the Athame, the gem and 100 gold?
entries.target: 怎么，你拿到仪式匕首、宝石和 100 金币了？

entries.source: [Give him the gem, the athame and 100 gold]
entries.target: [把宝石、仪式匕首和 100 金币交给他]

entries.source: Sorry, it seems I lack some stuff. I will be back.
entries.target: 抱歉，我好像还缺些材料。我会再来的。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The door opens and a shabby Elf emerges.*#WHITE#
Off we go to prepare the portal!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*门开了，一个衣衫褴褛的精灵走了出来。*#WHITE#
我们去准备制造传送门吧！

entries.source: [follow him]
entries.target: [跟着他]

entries.source: Welcome @playername@ to my shop.
entries.target: @playername@，欢迎来到我的商店。

entries.source: Let me see your wares.
entries.target: 让我看看你的商品吧。

entries.source: I am looking for mindstar training.
entries.target: 我是来学习灵晶掌握的。

entries.source: Sorry, I have to go!
entries.target: 抱歉，我要走了！

entries.source: I can teach you mindstar mastery (talent category Wild-gift/Mindstar mastery).  Learning the basics costs 100 gold, while more intensive training to gain proficiency costs 500 gold.  Once you're proficient, I can teach you some additional skills for 750 gold.
entries.target: 我能教授你灵晶掌握（自然/灵晶掌握 技能树）。基础训练需要 100 金币，进一步训练至熟练需要 500 金币。熟练之后，我还能以 750 金币的价格教你一些额外技巧。

entries.source: Just give me the basics (reveals locked talent category) - 100 gold.
entries.target: 只学习基础（揭示锁定的技能类别）- 100 金币。

entries.source: The shopkeeper spends some time with you, teaching you the basics of channeling energy through mindstars.
entries.target: 商人花了一些时间，教授你引导能量流经灵晶的基础方法。

entries.source: He is impressed with your affinity for natural forces.
entries.target: 他对你与自然力量的亲和度印象深刻。

entries.source: Please teach me what I need to know (unlocks talent category) - 500 gold.
entries.target: 请教授我需要知道的一切（解锁技能树）- 500 金币。

entries.source: The shopkeeper spends a great deal of time going over the finer details of channeling energy through mindstars with you.
entries.target: 商人花了大量时间，向你讲解引导能量流经灵晶的精妙细节。

entries.source: He is impressed with your mastery and shows you a few tricks to handle stronger energy flows.
entries.target: 他对你的熟练程度印象深刻，并向你展示了一些驾驭更强能量流的技巧。

entries.source: I'm already proficient, but I want to be an expert (improves talent mastery by 0.2) - 750 gold.
entries.target: 我已经熟练掌握了，但我想成为一名专家。（增加技能树系数0.2）- 750 金币。

entries.source: The shopkeeper spends a great deal of time going over the finer details of channeling energy through mindstars with you%s.
entries.target: 商人花了大量时间，向你讲解引导能量流经灵晶的精妙细节%s。

entries.source: , and teaches you enhanced mental discipline needed to maintain powerful energy fields
entries.target: ，并传授你如何加强精神修养，以维持强大的能量场

entries.source: No thanks.
entries.target: 不用了，谢谢。

entries.source: Well met, friend.
entries.target: 你好我的朋友。

entries.source: Farewell.
entries.target: 再见。

entries.source: Sister
entries.target: 姐妹

entries.source: Brother
entries.target: 兄弟

entries.source: You cannot use your %s anymore; it is tainted by magic.
entries.target: 你不能再使用 %s，它已被魔法所污染。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A grim-looking Fighter stands there, clad in mail armour and a large olive cloak. He doesn't appear hostile - his sword is sheathed.*#WHITE#
%s, our guild has been watching you and we believe that you have potential.
We see that the hermetic arts have always been at the root of each and every trial this land has endured, and we also see that one day they will bring about our destruction. So we have decided to take action by calling upon Nature to help us combat those who wield the arcane.
We can train you, but you need to prove you are pure, untouched by the eldritch forces, and ready to fight them to the end.
You will be challenged against magical foes. Should you defeat them, we will teach you our ways, and never again will you be able to be tainted by magic, or use it.

#LIGHT_RED#Note:  Completing this quest will forever prevent this character from using spells or items powered by arcane forces.  In exchange you'll be given access to a mindpower based generic talent tree, Anti-magic, and be able to unlock hidden properties in many arcane-disrupting items.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个面色阴沉的斗士站在那里，身穿锁甲，披着一件橄榄色大斗篷。他似乎没有敌意——剑还收在鞘中。*#WHITE#
%s，我们观察了你很久，你很有潜力。
我们看到，秘术一直是这片大地所经受的一次次磨难的根源，也看到它们终有一天会毁灭我们。因此，我们决定采取行动，借助自然之力对抗那些操纵奥术的人。
我们可以训练你，但你必须证明自己纯洁无瑕，未受奥术力量沾染，并已准备好与之战斗到底。
你将面对魔法敌人的挑战。若能击败他们，我们便会传授你我们的方法；从此以后，你将再也不会受魔法玷污，也无法使用魔法。

#LIGHT_RED#注：完成此任务会使该角色永久无法使用法术或由奥术之力驱动的物品。作为交换，你将解锁基于精神强度的通用技能树“反魔法”，并能解锁许多反魔法物品的隐藏属性。

entries.source: I will face your challenge!
entries.target: 我接受挑战！

entries.source: I'm not interested.
entries.target: 我没什么兴趣。

entries.source: Very well. I will say that this is disappointing, but it is your choice. Farewell.
entries.target: 好吧，不得不说我有点失望，不过这是你自己的选择，再见。

entries.source: Ah, you seem eager, but maybe still too young. Come back when you have grown a bit.
entries.target: 啊，你似乎跃跃欲试，但或许还太稚嫩。等你再成长一些再来吧。

entries.source: I shall.
entries.target: 我会的。

entries.source: Worry not, though, Ogre - we can replace your unclean runes with a newly-discovered mixture of infusions, eliminating your dependence on them.  The process will feel...  unpleasant, and will dramatically shorten your lifespan, but you will finally be free from the addictive grip of the arcane!
entries.target: 不过别担心，食人魔——我们可以用一种新发现的复合纹身配方替换你的不洁符文，让你不再依赖这些符文。这个过程会让你感到……不适，也会大幅缩短你的寿命，但你终将摆脱奥术令人上瘾的控制！

entries.source: We'll also reinforce the infusions you've been granted to replace your runes - the newest mixture should give you about five years of your life that the initial mixture took from you.
entries.target: 我们还会加强那些已授予你、用来替代符文的纹身——最新配方应该能弥补最初配方从你身上夺走的约五年寿命。

entries.source:
Very well. Before you start, we will make sure no magic can help you:
- You will not be able to use any spells or magical devices
- Any worn objects that are powered by the arcane will be unequipped
%s
Are you ready, or do you wish to prepare first?
entries.target:
很好。在开始之前，我们要确保没有魔法能助你一臂之力：
- 你将无法施放任何法术或使用任何魔法装置
- 所有已装备的奥术驱动物品都会被卸下
%s
准备好了吗？还是想先准备一下？

entries.source: I am ready
entries.target: 我准备好了。

entries.source: I need to prepare.
entries.target: 我需要准备一下。

entries.source:
#VIOLET#*You are grabbed by two olive-clad warriors and thrown into a crude arena!*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You hear the voice of the Fighter ring above you.*#WHITE#
%s! Your training begins! I want to see you prove your superiority over the works of magic! Fight!
entries.target:
#VIOLET#*你被两个身着橄榄色服装的战士抓了起来，扔进了一个简陋的角斗场里！*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你听到斗士的声音在你头顶上方响起！*#WHITE#
%s！你的训练开始了！我要看到你证明自己胜过魔法造物！战斗吧！

entries.source: But wha.. [you notice your first opponent is already there]
entries.target: 可什么……[你注意到你的第一个对手已经出现在战场上了]

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A naga steps through the portal, she seems to be a high ranked one.*#WHITE#
NO! You fool, the portal is breaking down!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个娜迦穿过传送门，她似乎身居高位。*#WHITE#
不！你这个蠢货，传送门正在崩溃！

entries.source: And thus my task is done, serpent!
entries.target: 那么，我的任务也完成了，臭蛇人！

entries.source: You do not understand: it will explode!
entries.target: 你不明白：它会爆炸！

entries.source:
The portal randomly teleported us before exploding.
You fool! You have doomed us, we could be #{bold}#anywhere!#{normal}#
DIE !
entries.target:
传送门在爆炸前把我们随机传送到了某个地方。
蠢货！你害惨我们了，我们可能身处#{bold}#任何地方#{normal}#！
死吧！
